facts.text: Under the Rowan Opportunity Program, students with family adjusted gross income between $0 and $65,000 annually pay $0 in net tuition and mandatory student fees.

sources.title: Rowan Opportunity Program - Rowan Sites - Rowan University
sources.quote: For students whose family's Adjusted Gross Income is between $0 and $65,000 annually, the net cost of tuition and mandatory student fees after all grants, scholarships, and ROP funding, will be $0.
